faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HNBGU Field Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the HNBGU Field Assistant recruitment is 25-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Field Assistant position at HNBGU is Graduation. Candidates must have completed their graduation from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Field Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Assistant post is 40 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Assistant position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 18,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the HNBGU Field Assistant job?
faq.answer: You can apply for the HNBGU Field Assistant job by sending your application and required documents via email to the official email address provided in the notification. The deadline for submission is 25-08-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the HNBGU Field Assistant recruitment involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates are advised to be prepared for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the HNBGU Field Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the HNBGU Field Assistant recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Field Assistant in the Hemvati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University (HNBGU) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Field Assistant position at HNBGU is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the university.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Field Assistant position is Srinagar Garhwal in the state of Uttarakhand.
